messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation MAP: staged rollout, canary & training — BlueHorizon

Hi Elaine & Tom,

Thanks again for signing — great to get BlueHorizon onboarded. Attached is the first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation steps we discussed: canary slice, migration windows, training cadence, and acceptance gates. High-level asks in this note:

- Can you confirm the preferred canary week (we proposed 2027-10-11 to 2027-10-15)?
- Confirm single point-of-contact for run-of-show during the canary (name + mobile).
- Any blackout dates for migration or training in Oct/Nov?

What I attached: BHL-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Canary-Acceptance-Criteria.pdf (pass/fail), Training-Schedule-Week1.pptx (draft).

Quick summary from our side:
- Rollout approach: staged by workspace — pilot workspace -> 3 production workspaces -> final cutover.
- Canary scope: 10% traffic, retention of KV cache, live fallback to w-1 model for 30 min.
- Migration strategy: rolling DNS + region-aware routing; rollback plan in MAP tab 3.
- Training: two 90-min train-the-trainer sessions + office hours for 2 weeks post-canary.

Next steps: if you confirm the canary week we’ll lock the engineering runbook, schedule load validation, and provision a dedicated canary pool.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this looks thorough, appreciate the level of detail. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Canary week — 2027-10-11 works but we have a scheduled marketing send on 2027-10-13 that will increase traffic for two hours midday. Can we plan the canary outside that window or agree on a strict 10:00–12:00 UTC blackout for the marketing spike?

2) Acceptance criteria — the latency SLA you call out (p95 < 400ms) is fine, but we need a written rollback SLT to present to our Ops. Can you call out the expected RTO for rollback in minutes?

3) Training — we prefer the first train-the-trainer on 2027-10-04 at 14:00 PT (we can make it shorter to 60 minutes). Will your team provide slides and a runbook?

CCing procurement to flag any billing alignment during the canary (we may want a short-term credit for the pilot traffic).

—Elaine

Thanks — good notes. Addressing each: 

1) Canary scheduling: we can shift the active canary window to 2027-10-11 -> 2027-10-12 and leave 10/13 as a blackout. The runbook will include a 30-minute warmup (09:30–10:00 UTC) and the active window 10:00–16:00 UTC on the two days. If you prefer a single-day narrow window (10:00–12:00 UTC) that's fine — we just recommend 48 hours of observation.

2) Rollback SLT / RTO: Delta rollback path is automated — failover to previous model + traffic steering within 5 minutes; full config rollback (DNS + infra) RTO expected ~20 minutes with our runbook. We'll include a one-page Rollback SLT summary in the MAP.

3) Training materials & runbook: yes — we'll provide slides, a 1-page run-of-show, and an editable runbook in Google Docs ahead of the session. 2027-10-04 14:00 PT works; we'll shorten to 60 minutes and cover: runbook walkthrough, canary validation checklist, incident escalation, and Q&A.

Action items I will carry:
- Lock canary to 10/11–10/12 and mark 10/13 as blackout (please confirm by EOD Friday).
- Share Rollback SLT one-pager and updated MAP v1.3 by next Tue (2027-09-07).
- Confirm trainer list for the 10/04 session; Priyom will run the session and send the calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments referenced: updated MAP tab will include a Rollback-SLT summary (tracked in BHL-MAP-v1.2.xlsx)
